revision: Package source manifests, no Git repository
baseline_flash: P2POLL Stage 6 firmware, 650 ms / 921600 verified twice
devices: Stationary COM4 anchor and Pi tag, existing temporary antenna delays
hypotheses: A 1 ms RF-task scheduling delay can skip the 800 us post-quiet status sampling window. A DW1000 event can already be latched.
Contiguous 2 Mbps output can overrun the CH340 delivery path. Compare exact known streams independently of RF and require RFB8 decoder completeness on both hosts.
repair: Stage 6 preserves the RF offsets and quiet intervals, uses short pauses near the receive deadline and checks latched events with hardware timestamp validation. The 2 Mbps path disables the ESP32 software TX ring and drains each bounded burst before applying the idle gap.
acceptance: In each condition, 100 matched complete records per endpoint, all 400 raw CIR slots, P1 and P2 independently verified common axes and power grids 100/100 each, zero CRC/schema/sequence gaps, firmware drops, faults or period misses, 99 RF cadence intervals within 4 ms of target, both SELFTEST and STOP confirmed.
limits: Applies to these static 100-transaction trials and the installed USB paths. Absolute physical-axis accuracy and complex-phase coherence are outside scope.
